meta.title: Ground Truth
meta.geography: NYC community districts (59), UHF42 neighborhoods (42), citywide years
meta.graph_citation: System, Inc. (2026). System Public Graph (Version 2.1) [Data set]. Harvard Dataverse. https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/7V6JDO
rules: Research direction: majority sign of findings with a readable direction (ratio CI wholly above or below 1; signed coefficient or correlation with CI excluding 0 or p < 0.05). 'mixed' if fewer than 70% agree. Variables named 'lack of', 'low', 'no' etc. count in the opposite direction. Animal studies excluded.
City test: Spearman rank correlation across areas; partial Spearman controlling for poverty; bootstrap 95% CI; Benjamini–Hochberg false discovery rate 10% across all city tests.
Confirmed: city sign matches research, significant after correction, and the sign survives poverty control.
Contested: city sign opposes research and is significant, or opposes it both before and after poverty control.
Bridged: research links each step of a chain, no single dataset holds both ends, and the city end-to-end test has the predicted sign and is significant. Each middle link is reported.
Inconclusive: everything else. Every non-confirmed claim says what data would settle it.

notes: Excluded zcM5Dx94UD (bridge-trees-heat-ed): "air temperature" and "community-acquired pneumonia hospitalizations among those aged ≥ 65 years", relative risk 1.89 [1.01 to 3.56]. The paper's RR 1.89 is for low temperature (cold, lags 0-5 days); the graph dropped the qualifier, so the direction is reversed.
Our code read "poor mental health" as the absence of harm, so 2 cold-home findings counted backwards. Fixed: the cold-harm end no longer flips on words like "poor" or "lower".
